title: Riot Squad BAR EDTN Lychee Watermelon 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Lychee Watermelon from Riot Squad’s BAR EDTN range is an astonishingly tasty tropical flavour bursting with fruity bliss. The delicately sweet and juicy taste of Lychee pairs perfectly with luscious notes of fresh Watermelon, creating an endlessly uplifting and refreshing vape it’s impossible to tire of. This e-liquid’s 40% VG / 60% PG formulation delivers the perfect balance of flavour and cloud production while the nicotine salt formulation ensures a super-smooth and comfortable throat sensation. Riot Squad’s BAR EDTN e-liquids are perfect for use in starter vape kits and low-powered pod devices. Unlike regular freebase e-liquids, nicotine salts’ alkaline formulation allows for a higher concentration of nicotine while delivering a smoother throat hit than high-strength freebase liquids are capable of. With nicotine salt e-liquids, the nicotine is absorbed into the bloodstream faster, providing near-instant relief from nicotine cravings. This makes Nic salt e-liquids a great choice for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by Nic salts. BAR EDTN is a mouth-watering collection of nic salt e-liquids inspired by Riot Squad’s hugely popular disposable Riot Bar flavours . Just like those Riot Bars, Bar EDTN keeps the flavours simple, sweet, and deliciously satisfying, so you always know how your e-juice will taste before you buy it. If you love this flavour, why not treat yourself to the others in Riot Squad’s BAR EDTN collection? From super-refreshing Watermelon Ice to a classic Cherry Cola and smooth and creamy Mango Vanilla, whatever your taste in e-liquid, BAR EDTN has an incredible flavour waiting for you.
